A COLLABORATION WITH NATURE

You write the notes.
He brings the energy.

01 / THE RHYTHM

A wheel with a pulse.

When he runs, the tempo follows his real RPM. When he rests, the beat slows and the instruments soften. Naps sound good, too.

02 / THE HARMONY

New rounds. Fresh harmony.

Confirmed wheel rounds shape the musical key. Your notes stay yours. The next harmony arrives gently, at the start of a bar.

03 / YOUR CREATION

Keep a little moment.

Save a session, send its composition link, or take four bars home as a WAV. All sounds are synthesized right here in your browser.
